content:
From the datasheet, lane center wavelengths are four co-listed ranges in one optical table (one 4×10G CWDM module). Reach **40 km** is the ER4 application; **0.3 km** comes from the Data Rate Specifications row (SMF-28 link distance max 300 m). Per-lane signaling is **10.3125 Gb/s**; stressed sensitivity (**-16.8 dBm**) is a separate receiver test condition in the same section as **-19 dBm** sensitivity.

**Note:** The last two aggregate modes reuse wavelength pairs only to satisfy one min/max per mode; the datasheet does not tie 41.25 vs 41.3 or 10.5 dBm total power to separate application rows. A stricter reading is **four lane modes** plus **one** mode for SMF-28 **0.3 km** (Data Rate table) and **one** for stressed RX (**-16.8 dBm**), without inventing aggregate-only modes. If you want that minimal set only, say so and we can trim to 5–6 modes.
